parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by ‘blood phobia’.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe features of the blood injection phobia inventory (BIPI).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain one similarity and one difference between the BIPI and the Generalised Anxiety
Disorder assessment (GAD-7).

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe the characteristics of impulse control disorders and non-substance addictive
disorder (definitions, types, measures).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate the characteristics of impulse control disorders and non-substance addictive
disorder (definitions, types, measures), including a discussion about self-reports. 
Psychology and consumer behaviour

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Identify two of the virtual store layouts in the study by Vrechopoulos (2004) on the interior
layout of grocery stores.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe two results from the study by Vrechopoulos.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain one strength and one weakness of the study by Vrechopoulos.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about choice heuristics in consumer
decision-making (availability/representativeness, anchoring and purchase quantity decisions,
pre-cognitive decisions).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about choice heuristics in consumer
decision-making (availability/representativeness, anchoring and purchase quantity decisions,
pre-cognitive decisions), including a discussion about generalisability. 
Psychology and health

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Outline one reason why patients do not adhere to medical advice.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the study on improving adherence using the Funhaler by Watt et al. (2003).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain one strength and one weakness of the study by Watt et al.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about individual factors in changing health
beliefs (unrealistic optimism, transtheoretical model, health change in adolescents).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about individual factors in changing health
beliefs (unrealistic optimism, transtheoretical model, health change in adolescents), including
a discussion of practical applications. 
Psychology and organisations

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Outline one universalist theory of leadership.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the contingency theory of leadership proposed by Fiedler (1967).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain one strength and one weakness of the contingency theory of leadership.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about temporal conditions of work environments
(shift-work, effects of shift-work on health, shift-work and accidents).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about temporal conditions of work environments
(shift-work, effects of shift-work on health, shift-work and accidents), including a discussion
about ecological validity.
